sources.relevant_excerpt: Holders of passports issued by the countries, entities or territories listed in the table below are granted visa-free travel to Hungary for a definite period of time. [...] 90 days always refer to a maximum period of stay in any 180-day period. [...] In accordance with Article 6 (1) (a) of the Schengen Borders Code the validity of the travel document shall last until at least three months after the intended date of departure from the territory of the Member States and the travel document shall have been issued within the previous 10 years. Table entries confirmed: United States 90 days; United Kingdom 90 days (plus BNO, BOTC, BOC, BPP, BS categories); Japan 90 days; South Korea 90 days; Singapore 90 days; Hong Kong SAR 90 days (SAR passport); Taiwan 90 days (passport must include identity card number); Australia 90 days; Canada 90 days; Brazil 90 days; United Arab Emirates 90 days; Germany and France 90 days (ordinary passport or national ID card, EU/EEA); China: diplomatic 90 days / service 30 days only (ordinary passports NOT visa-free); India: diplomatic/official passports only; Russia: service passports only. Biometric passports required for ordinary-passport holders of Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia and Ukraine. Legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806.

sources.relevant_excerpt: Hungary is a Member State of the Schengen Agreement as of 21 December, 2007. [...] The Schengen regulations are only applicable for a stay not exceeding 90 days. The page is the MFA hub distinguishing short-term stays (not exceeding 90 days, Schengen C visa) from long-stay entries (exceeding 90 days), directing applicants to consular application channels. No eVisa, electronic travel authorization or visa-on-arrival channel is offered for tourism.

sources.search_query: direct navigation from https://konzinfo.mfa.gov.hu/en/how-apply-visa (query family: Hungary tourist visa fee)
sources.relevant_excerpt: Schengen C (short-stay) visa fee: EUR 90 for adults, EUR 45 for children aged 6-12, children under 6 exempt. Applications must be submitted in person at a consulate where the applicant has habitual residence; applications can be filed 6 months - 15 days before the start of the intended visit. The decision about the admissible applications are to be made within 15 calendar days from the date of submission (extendable to 45 days). Travel document must contain at least two blank pages, be issued within the previous 10 years, and remain valid at least three months after the intended date of departure. Tourism documentation: the certificate of the travel agency; or in the case of an individual visit: the prepaid reservation of accommodation. A visa is only a preliminary permission for entry, and not an automatic entry authorization.

policies.policy_name: Visa exemption under Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 Annex II (Schengen short-stay)
policies.description: Nationals of third countries listed in Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 are exempt from the visa requirement for stays not exceeding 90 days in any 180-day period. EU/EEA citizens enter freely with passport or national ID card. Special conditions: Hong Kong and Macao SAR passports qualify; Taiwan passports must contain an identity card number; ordinary-passport holders of Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia and Ukraine need biometric passports; Serbian passports issued by the Serbian Coordination Directorate are excluded; several British national categories (BNO, BOTC, BOC, BPP, BS) are also exempt.
conditions: Maximum stay 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen Area
Passport valid at least 3 months after intended departure and issued within the previous 10 years
Biometric passport required for ordinary-passport holders of Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia and Ukraine
Taiwan passports must include an identity card number; Hong Kong/Macao must hold SAR passports

policies.policy_name: Schengen short-stay (C) visa via Hungarian consulates
policies.description: Non-exempt nationals must obtain a Schengen C visa before travel, applied for in person at the Hungarian consulate covering their habitual residence; in several jurisdictions applications are lodged through visa application centers operated by VFS Global. Applications may be filed 6 months to 15 days before the intended visit; decisions within 15 calendar days (extendable to 45). The visa is valid for the whole Schengen Area. Tourist supporting documents: travel-agency certificate or prepaid accommodation reservation.
conditions: In-person submission at the competent Hungarian consulate or its mandated visa application center
